ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level ratio characterized by a dominant high-intensity white central field (approx 85%) bordered by a low-intensity black perimeter and trailing edge (approx 15%).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white central area; black pigmentation localized to the trailing edges, distal tips, and central peduncle region; two distinct regions of low-saturation brownish-orange staining are mapped to the inner-upper quadrants of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped notch; approx 80-degree convergence angle at the central peduncle intersection.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys) along the entire trailing edge boundary, with particularly deep jagged irregularites on the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trailing edge trajectory sweeping upwards and outwards towards sharp, narrow distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast calcified clusters (barnacles) localized at the extreme distal tips of both left and right lobes; additional punctate black spots along the upper margins.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Vertical dark linear pixel disruptions extending upwards from the central peduncle into the white ventral field, appearing as parallel rake-like streaks.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular tearing/notching along the trailing edge topography; heavy barnacle colonization on both lateral tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Symmetrical brownish-orange oxidation or biological staining localized on the proximal white surface of both fluke lobes.
